name: Hamsafar WhatsApp Integration

parameter.name: Body
parameter.value:
Assalam-o-Alaikum! 🌙 Main Hamsafar hoon — aapka AI mental health companion.

*Yeh kya hai?*
Main aapki emotional wellbeing mein madad karta hoon — anxiety, stress, family pressure, burnout — English ya Roman Urdu mein baat kar saktay hain.

⚠️ *Important:* Main ek AI prototype hoon, ek therapist nahi. Emergency mein Umang Pakistan se rabta karein: *0311-7786264* (Free, 24/7)

*Kya aap consent dete hain ke main apni conversations yaad rakhun?*
Jawab dein: *Haan* ya *Nahi*

meta.description: Hamsafar WhatsApp Integration via Twilio Sandbox. Routes incoming WhatsApp messages to the FastAPI backend and sends replies back.

_env_vars_required.HAMSAFAR_BACKEND_URL: Your deployed FastAPI backend URL, e.g. https://your-app.railway.app
_env_vars_required.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID: Your Twilio Account SID from console.twilio.com
_env_vars_required.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN: Your Twilio Auth Token (set as n8n credential)
_env_vars_required.TWILIO_WHATSAPP_NUMBER: Your Twilio Sandbox WhatsApp number e.g. +14155238886

_setup_instructions: 1. Import this JSON into n8n: Workflows > Import from File
2. Set up Twilio credentials in n8n: Settings > Credentials > Add Credential > Twilio API
3. Set environment variables HAMSAFAR_BACKEND_URL and TWILIO_WHATSAPP_NUMBER in n8n
4. Activate the workflow and get the webhook URL from the Webhook node
5. In Twilio Console > Messaging > Try it Out > Send a WhatsApp message, set the webhook URL as: <your-n8n-url>/webhook/whatsapp-inbound
6. Test by sending 'join <sandbox-keyword>' to your Twilio Sandbox number on WhatsApp, then send any message
